items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
#Spurs and second-year guard Taelon Peter have agreed to a training camp deal, a league source confirmed.

The 6-foot-3 Peter, the 54th pick of the 2025 NBA Draft, averaged 4.5 points in 38 games for Indiana last season on a two-way contract. 

Deal first reported by @hoopshype.

items.title: The San Antonio Spurs and Taelon Peter have agreed to a deal, league sources told HoopsHype. Peter will go to training camp with the Spurs after averaging 4.5 points in 38 games played for the Indiana Pacers last season. Peter was the 54th overall pick of the 2025 NBA Draft.
